title: Life Is Messy
description: Heather and Ian are hanging on by a thread: with two kids under three who don't sleep, and the end of maternity leave around the corner, they are exhausted and living in a constant state of anxiety and frustration; they're so overrun with clutter that their deep soaker tub has become storage; Kortney and Kenny rescue the pair by creating child-safe storage solutions, a custom kitchen pantry to get organized, and a revamped basement with a tub used for baths, not storage.

title: Life Is Messy
description: After moving into their three-bedroom forever home, Catherine and Rob found out they were pregnant again and immediately felt the squeeze; managing three kids, two large dogs, and nightly musical beds, exhaustion has taken over and their home has descended into total chaos; Kortney and Kenny devise solutions with the grown-ups and the kids to bring back the beauty and the calm, so their house can stay their forever home.

title: Life Is Messy
description: Shanelle is tired of feeling like a teenager. As a single mom living temporarily in her father's home, she and her son Elijah are feeling boxed in. Their footprint is limited to three bedrooms, including one for her home business, but they are all bursting at the seams with years of clutter, clothing and nail tech gear. Kortney and Kenny reimagine the life they could live, creating two beautiful bedrooms and a stunning nail salon that will get business booming.

title: Life Is Messy
description: Mel and Roy have lost control of their home; their creative and energetic kids have turned the entire main floor into an art explosion that knows no boundaries; even the walls have turned into a kiddie canvas; feeling embarrassed and overwhelmed, no amount of effort seems to help; Kortney and Kenny sharpen their focus to create some order: a dedicated space for art, a reorganized kitchen, a tranquil room for adulting, and a proper dining room is finally born.

title: Life Is Messy
description: Matt and Sam are at their wit's end. The daily grind of raising two young kids while juggling careers and Matt's busy marathon schedule has worn them down. They have no time to keep their home organized and clutter has consumed their lives, taking a toll on their relationship. Kortney and Kenny help them through the emotional journey of letting go, so they can get their home organized, functional, and a place to love again.

title: Life Is Messy
description: Ranjit bought her little home when she was a bachelorette; fast-forward 20 years later, and the walls are closing in on her family of three. Ranjit and husband Nabeel are in desperate need of a reset, but they don't know how to start. Kortney and Kenny guide them through a massive declutter, turning a man cave into a teenage-friendly space, making room for living, and calming the chaos.
